question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Microsoft)

calls.reasoning: Q1 FY27 guidance is $89.85-90.95B (midpoint 90.4B) and consensus is about $90.65B (FactSet/Zacks/Visible Alpha). Over the last 4 quarters Microsoft beat consensus by roughly $2.3B, $1.0B, $1.5B and $2.4B, landing $0.7-2.2B above the top of its guidance. The Q4 FY26 beat was the largest, driven by Azure capacity and GitHub Copilot consumption. Applying a typical beat of about $1.6-1.8B over the guidance midpoint gives roughly $92.0-92.3B. Downside risk: Azure capacity constraints or an FX shift. A result outside 90.2-94.5B would take a miss below guidance or a beat of more than $3.5B over the top of guidance, both rare. No human market found: the harness found none on Polymarket/Manifold, and my Kalshi search turned up nothing.
calls.dossier:
- Q4 FY26 (Jun-2026 quarter): revenue $90.0B, +18% (+17% cc); Intelligent Cloud $39.3B, +32% (Microsoft press release, 2026-07-29).
- Q1 FY27 guidance (Amy Hood, Q4 call, 2026-07-29): total $89.85-90.95B (+16-17%); FX to cut total growth by <1pt; P&BP $36.7-37.0B; IC $40.95-41.25B with Azure ~45% cc; MPC $12.2-12.7B (earnings call transcript, Motley Fool).
- Q1 FY27 is the first report under a new two-segment structure (TIKR, Oct 2026); one item says devices/consumer recast at $14.7-15.2B. The total-revenue guide is unchanged.
- Consensus as of late Oct 2026: about $90.63-90.71B (FactSet $90.63B; Visible Alpha about $90.7B; Zacks $90.63B).
- Guidance-vs-actual history: Q4 FY26 guide $86.7-87.8B, actual $90.0B (consensus about $87.5B); Q3 FY26 actual $82.89B vs consensus $81.39B (SiliconANGLE, 2026-04-29); Q2 FY26 actual $81.27B vs guide $79.5-80.6B; Q1 FY26 actual $77.67B vs guide about $75.5-76.6B.
- Beat over the top of guidance in the last 4 quarters: about $0.7-2.2B. Beat over consensus: about $1.0-2.5B.
- Q4 drivers: Azure capacity coming online faster, efficiency gains, and GitHub Copilot consumption after the June pricing change.
- BofA (Tal Liani) estimates Azure about 44.8% cc, about $32.3B.
- Q1 FY27 capex guided above $50B. The stock is up about 39% since June 30.
- Status quo: actual comes in at or above the top of guidance, as in each of the last 8+ quarters.
- Resolution: off the revenue in Microsoft's 8-K/press release on Oct 28, 2026, not consensus or later revisions. Event window: quarter Jul 1 -> Sep 30, 2026; the release is due Oct 28; as of Oct 25 the quarter has fully elapsed and the release is 3 days away.
- Searched without finding: actual Jul-Sep 2026 USD index moves vs guidance assumptions; any Kalshi/Polymarket market (none found).

calls.reconciliation: All three runs share the same guidance, consensus and beat history; medians differ only $91.9B vs $92.2B. Factual: exact Q3 FY26 guidance unverified (beat ~1.5-2.1%), immaterial to the median; ChartMill $92.46B consensus is an outlier vs FactSet/Zacks/Visible Alpha ~$90.6-90.7B, so not weighted as consensus. Judgment: guidance-midpoint beat framing (Runs 1, 3) vs consensus-beat framing (Run 2) — I took ~$92.2B given the consistent at-or-above-top-of-guide record and accelerating recent beats. Dispersion carried forward near Runs 1/3. No web retrieval this run.
